name: Band-Assisted Pull-Up
cues: Loop a band over the bar and set one knee or both feet in it
Pick a band that lets you finish every rep
Pull your chest toward the bar from a full hang
Lower under control until your arms are straight

qa.note: Approved by the owner 2026-10-09 (bulk approval of waves 3b and 3c). Earlier findings, kept for follow-up: Wave 3b 2026-10-09: rated minor, owner review. needs work: The band runs, which no gate checks, pass through the body. My FK: band_front to bar goes 44 mm into thigh_l at frame 19. At the bottom hang (frame 60), band_back to knee goes 10 mm into the trunk, 16 mm into thigh_l and 17 mm into girdle_l. The knee wrap (r 0.056) sits 14 mm inside the shank capsule. All of it is hidden from the rear hero. The pull-up kinematics themselves match the parent (elbow 6 to 135, elevation 70 to 164). | minor: Fixed in vertical-pull.ts and band-pose.ts. The knee wrap is re-centred on the front shank capsule's axis ([0.013, -0.13, -0.02] in the tibia frame) with radius 0.07 (shank 0.0612 + half the band + BAND_CLEAR), 3 cm lower so the strands start clear of the knee end of the thigh. Each strand now has 3 free points (at 0.06, 0.2 and 0.5 of the way up from the shin), placed by a new additive helper drape() in band-pose.ts. drape checks the real polyline against the body capsules (shank_l and hands excluded) and pushes points forward and out (lateral strand) or in (medial strand) until every sample clears by BAND_CLEAR. Over 48 samples per loop, every band segment clears every non-hand capsule by at least 5.5 mm, wrap included. Before the fix: 44 mm into the thigh, 10-17 mm into the trunk and girdle, wrap 14 mm inside the shank. Node motion is continuous (largest step 20 mm per 1/240 loop, from the knee itself). Size is 11470 of 12288 B (5 nodes per strand went over the limit). QA passes, the pull-up kinematics are untouched, and the hero and side sheets render. What's left: at the bottom hang the medial strand bows forward over the knee and crosses in front of the right thigh (about 10 cm off it at z 0.28), so it reads as a draped band, not a taut one. This is mostly hidden from the rear hero.
